text:
```yaml
name: Gemini Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Gemini Code Review
        uses: google-github-actions/gemini-code-review@v1
        with:
          model: gemini-2.5-flash
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
```
